data.description:
## Description

**What**: For every REVIEW-DEFENSE flagged walking-skeleton-needs-followon-check, cross-reference cited follow-on epic/ticket via dso ticket show and dispose.

**Why**: SC-4 requires walking-skeleton defenses backed by an open follow-on ticket OR a shipped consumer.

**Scope**: (a) follow-on open → leave intact, log verified-open; (b) follow-on closed AND consumer shipped → remove defense (stale); (c) follow-on closed but consumer NOT shipped → file new bug capturing discrepancy, leave defense pending bug; (d) no follow-on cited OR cited ID does not exist → create new follow-on task capturing deferred work with comment text + location, update defense to cite new ticket ID.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every walking-skeleton REVIEW-DEFENSE has verified status: verified-open / consumer-shipped-removed / discrepancy-bug-filed / new-followon-ticket-created
- All newly-created follow-on tickets linked back to epic 5018-64ce via parent or relates-to
- docs/findings/epic-5018-64ce-todo-sweep.md walking-skeleton section enumerates each finding and verification outcome
- Re-running audit-review-defenses.sh shows zero walking-skeleton defenses with status=needs-followon-check
- Pre-existing test suite still passes
data.title: UPDATE: Verify walking-skeleton / not-wired-yet REVIEW-DEFENSE follow-on tickets
